high_level_overview.overview: This JCL job performs an FTP file transfer operation, sending a mainframe dataset ('AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST') to a remote server as a text file ('welcome.txt'). It connects to a remote FTP server at IP address 172.31.21.124 using provided credentials, navigates to a designated folder ('/ftpfolder'), and transfers the file in ASCII mode. The job appears to be part of a card demonstration application, likely used to export mainframe data to an external system or file repository.

parameters.name: JOB
parameters.description: The accounting information or programmer name associated with the job. Here it is set to 'FTP JCL' as a simple job identifier string.

parameters.name: CLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the job class (input queue) to which the job is assigned. CLASS=A routes the job to job class A, which determines scheduling priority and resource allocation by the JES subsystem.

parameters.name: MSGCLASS
parameters.description: Specifies the output class for the job log (system messages). MSGCLASS=H routes the job's message output to output class H, determining where the job log is sent (e.g., held for online viewing).

parameters.name: MSGLEVEL
parameters.description: Controls the level of JCL and system messages printed in the job log. The first value (1) prints all JCL statements including those from procedures; the second value (1) prints all system messages including those for non-abnormal terminations.

parameters.name: REGION
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of virtual storage available to the entire job. REGION=0M means the job can use the maximum available region size, effectively removing memory constraints at the job level.

parameters.name: NOTIFY
parameters.description: Specifies the TSO user ID to be notified when the job completes. &SYSUID is a symbolic parameter that resolves to the user ID of the person who submitted the job, so that user receives a completion notification message.

parameters.name: TIME
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum CPU time allowed for the entire job in minutes. TIME=1440 sets the limit to 1440 minutes (24 hours), effectively allowing the job to run without a practical CPU time restriction.

job_details.purpose: Transfers a mainframe dataset to a remote FTP server using IBM's z/OS FTP utility. Connects to the remote server at 172.31.21.124, navigates to the target directory, and uploads the mainframe file as a text file.
job_details.inputs: SYSIN (FTP subcommands: server IP 172.31.21.124, credentials carddemousr/ftpdemo1, ASCII mode, pwd, dir, cd /ftpfolder); Source dataset: AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST
job_details.outputs: welcome.txt uploaded to /ftpfolder on remote FTP server 172.31.21.124

data_operations.description: The FTP PUT command reads the mainframe dataset AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST and transfers it to the remote FTP server at 172.31.21.124 as the file welcome.txt in the /ftpfolder directory.
